assessment_objectives.objective: the Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) for which an Indentured Bill of Materials (IBOM) is required are defined.
an Indentured Bill of Materials (IBOM) is generated for internally produced Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS), or obtained from the supplier for acquired TAAS.
each Indentured Bill of Materials (IBOM) documents the hierarchical relationship between assemblies, sub-assemblies and components, such that each component can be traced to its parent assembly.
Indentured Bills of Materials (IBOMs) are updated when assemblies, sub-assemblies or components are added, replaced or removed.
